bitcoin_articles.headline: Strive, Inc. Announces $4.2 Billion Expansion of Bitcoin Acquisition Funding Program
bitcoin_articles.summary: Strive, Inc. has announced a $4.2 billion expansion of its at-the-market (ATM) program to support its ongoing Bitcoin treasury strategy.

bitcoin_articles.headline: CME Group Launches Bitcoin Volatility Index Futures
bitcoin_articles.summary: CME Group has officially launched its new Bitcoin Volatility Index (BVX) futures, enabling institutional investors to trade 30-day implied volatility on Bitcoin.

bitcoin_articles.headline: BlackRock Transfers Additional Digital Assets to Coinbase
bitcoin_articles.summary: BlackRock has executed a transfer of 929 Bitcoin and 36,449 Ethereum to Coinbase as part of its ongoing operational management of digital assets.
